column1: # Editorial estimates that the AKC trait ratings don't cover. 1-5 scales unless noted.
# prey: chase/prey drive (5 = will chase cats
# alone: copes with being left alone (1 = prone to separation distress
# heat / cold: tolerance of hot / cold weather
# recall: off-leash reliability (1 = will leave and not come back
# care: extra ear / eye / skin-fold / cord care beyond the coat (0 none
# health: known breed health burden (1 = generally robust
# brachy: 1 if flat-faced (breathing and overheating risk)
